truth_boundary: No real law firm, legal advice, legal intake, results, credentials, staff, or real accident portrayal. Local noindex demo. Generated photos labeled illustrative.
source_registry_note: Registry's minimal-gallery entry is marked curated but has obsolete minimalgallery.com URL and a temporary DNS-unavailable note. This run verified its live canonical minimal.gallery directory, editorial policy and individual entries; no registry file changed.
review: Source selection and visual evaluation by producing assistant, not independent or owner approval. All four packaged studies returned ok:true and problems:[]; capture limitations above remain explicit.

accessibility_adjustments.measured_issue: rgb(245,105,85) on white has 2.985:1 contrast, below even the large-text threshold
accessibility_adjustments.change: Use the same sheet's rgb(75,17,13) for reading text. Retain coral for the large identity wordmark and dark-ground control text.

motion_revision.reason: First implementation stuck individual panels briefly without content moving through a held section; it did not reproduce the source's 2592-3888px holding sequence.
motion_revision.implementation: A viewport-tall sticky practice stage holds for the source-measured 3888px of desktop scroll. Later pale panels move up together at their different slower rates, leaving prior titles exposed. The last panel and underlying stage use the source's dark red ground, matching its final network panel. The compact navigation sits above reserved header space. Phones and reduced-motion use normal reading flow. Covered panel links were removed so keyboard users cannot focus occluded controls.
